title: Existing degreewise dévissage for a finite cohomological interval
statement: Let C be an abelian category with derived category D(C) [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and its standard t-structure [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. Let Q be a property of objects of D(C), invariant under isomorphism, containing every zero object and closed under extensions in distinguished triangles [def-weil-triangulated-category]. For every integer q let P_q be an isomorphism-invariant property of objects of C. Suppose Q(M[0][-q]) whenever P_q(M). For n∈ℕ, a∈ℤ and K∈D(C) with H^q(K)=0 outside [a,a+n-1], assume P_q(H^q(K)) for a≤q<a+n. Then Q(K). No closure of Q under shifts and no zero-object hypothesis on P_q is required.

proof.text: Induct on n. If n=0, M lies both in degrees at least a and at most a-1; every cohomology vanishes and the standard t-structure makes M zero. Apply the hypothesis that Q contains every zero object.

proof.text: For n+1 put b=a+n. The standard truncation triangle is A=τ<b M → M → B=τ≥b M → A[1]. The upper bound on M makes B concentrated in degree b; choose the canonical shifted-heart identification B≅Y[b]. The long exact cohomology sequence gives H^b(M)≅Y. Transport P_b through this isomorphism and then use the supplied degree-b single-object hypothesis and repleteness of Q to obtain Q(B).

proof.text: A lies in [a,b-1]. For every a≤q<b, its inclusion into M induces H^q(A)≅H^q(M), so repleteness transports P_q to H^q(A). The induction hypothesis gives Q(A). Apply extension closure of Q to A→M→B to obtain Q(M). All steps are the existing proved degreewise source lemma; no shift stability of Q is required.

lemma prop_of_isGE_of_isLE_of_degreewise (Q : ObjectProperty (DerivedCategory C))
    [Q.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms] (hQ₀ : ∀ M, IsZero M → Q M)
    (hQ : ∀ T ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory C), Q T.obj₁ → Q T.obj₃ → Q T.obj₂)
    (P : ℤ → ObjectProperty C) [∀ q, (P q).IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
    (hP : ∀ q X, P q X → Q ((singleFunctor C q).obj X)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (a : ℤ) (M : DerivedCategory C), M.IsGE a → M.IsLE (a + n - 1) →
      (∀ q, a ≤ q → q < a + n → P q ((homologyFunctor C q).obj M)) → Q M
